subject_identity_preserved.rationale: The same skateboarder is maintained after shot 0: black helmet, black shirt with white lettering, dark pants, skateboard, and pink shoes recur. Shot 0 is partially cropped so identity evidence is weaker there.

background_coherent.rationale: All shots remain in the same outdoor skate bowl with tan curved walls, concrete floor, blue rail/fence elements, trees, and strong daylight.

per_shot_adherence.issue: Low concrete/bowl view and fast left-to-right roll are plausible, but the rider is heavily cropped.
Side/tracking carve in the bowl is clear.
Ollie/action near the lip is clear and invariant clothing is preserved, though the overhead angle is only partial.
Sharp turning motion is visible, but the view is not strongly behind the rider.
Telephoto-like distance and crossing motion are plausible, with some background blur/streaking.
Front three-quarter roll-out and board steadying are plausible, though the rider is tightly cropped.

inter_shot_diversity.rationale: Shots vary in distance, action phase, and framing while staying within the same skate-bowl event.

motion_continuity.rationale: The sequence shows plausible progression through rolling, carving, jumping, turning, crossing, and recovering rather than freezing.

which_cut_broke.how: No single transition clearly breaks consistency; the weakest continuity evidence is from the cropped shot 0 into shot 1.

cheat_flags.rationale: Frames are distinct and show varied action/camera setups without copied poses or static repetition.
